cross-015.answer: Two Efforts are no longer active. The shader compile cache and build farm Effort (eff-shader-compile-cache-and-build-farm--6xeac11zxvwwarkn) is completed: its retrospective, fnd-retrospective-on-the-shader-compile-cache--9rpv2a60ach04cx6, says the cache has run on every farm build for five weeks, which meets the Effort's stated end condition. The co-op rollback netcode prototype (eff-co-op-rollback-netcode-prototype--n5ejm416kfcfap49) is abandoned: dec-abandon-rollback-netcode-for-co-op--46envrg0v4pdwv7b stops it because re-running tides every rollback frame costs 4.8 ms on Skiff, so co-op will not ship with rollback.

netcode-004.answer: The team abandoned rollback because co-op peers must agree on tide state bit for bit, and rollback re-runs tides every rolled-back frame, costing 4.8 ms on Skiff (a fifth of the 25 ms frame), while shrinking the window and quarter-resolution tides both failed. The reason depends on the world Decision dec-run-the-tide-simulation-in-32-32-fixed-point--c5rjfcnmhne4h05e.

ports-012.answer: The team raised the Skiff dynamic resolution floor to 576p because saltglass caustics shimmered badly in motion at the 540p floor, even after Tern (7 of 10 dune views, versus 2 of 10 at 576p), per `dec-raise-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-576p--fep9q7m08pp9f0bb` citing `fnd-saltglass-caustics-shimmer-at-the-540p-floor--0aa8sts89vhq1s6q`. That 576p decision is now superseded by a 504p floor (`dec-lower-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-504p--15esnt90gcn29enn`).

ports-013.answer: Ship Tern as Lantern's only upscaler

render-031.answer: Alpha-tested foliage cost 2.1 ms in the visibility buffer, and a forward pass brought it to 0.8 ms; saltglass moved to a forward pass after the resolve so it could refract the resolved scene behind it. Record: dec-visibility-buffer-for-opaque-geometry-foliage-an--gvnvp04jgm7kbfh9

render-032.answer: Tern was chosen because Halcyon has no Skiff build, and shipping a second upscaler on two platforms would break the one-upscaler constraint; the team also wanted to own the upscaler code, since saltglass refraction and caustics need upscaler changes they can make the same week rather than vendor tickets (dec-ship-tern-as-lantern-s-only-upscaler--fmreq35nzyjc7k4e).

render-046.answer: Because the cost Finding that had sunk virtual shadow maps was a capture error: with cached pages, VSM costs 1.4 ms, less than four cascades (1.6 ms), and cascade seams through saltglass remained unsolved under CSM. (dec-use-virtual-shadow-maps-for-the-sun--x8nqkn9q7eaf1ap4)

render-047.answer: Because the release-build capture showed the visibility buffer at 7.4 ms on Skiff versus 8.1 ms for forward+ (6.3 ms with material resolve at half rate), so the forward+ fallback was no longer worth keeping, and maintaining two opaque paths cost about one engineer-week a month in fixes. Record: dec-visibility-buffer-on-all-platforms-skiff-resolve--k1ackk3c3275r5y1.

world-036.answer: Kestrel retired fibers for engine jobs on 2026-04-14 because 41% of alpha crash reports had no usable stack, which blocked crash triage for beta. The fiber scheduler bought only about two points of utilisation (95% vs 93% for continuations), not enough to outweigh the unreadable crashes and the Gull thread-local bug. See dec-return-engine-jobs-to-a-thread-pool-with-continu--1zkc1v2x97taf50h.

world-051.answer: Float tides drifted apart between machines within 6 minutes, from FMA contraction and a Skiff sin() that differed by one ulp, and integer fixed point gives identical bits on every CPU and compiler with no platform math library; the graph does not record a strict IEEE mode comparison. dec-run-the-tide-simulation-in-32-32-fixed-point--c5rjfcnmhne4h05e
